verses.text: <pb/><t>Yabo ya tabbata ga Ubangiji! <pb/>Mai farin ciki ne mutumin da yake tsoron Ubangiji,</t> <t>Mai farin ciki ne shi wanda yake jin daɗin yin biyayya da umarnansa.</t>
<t>'Ya'yansa za su zama manyan ƙasar,</t> <t>Zuriyar mutumin kirki za ta yi albarka.</t>
<t>Iyalinsa za su zama attajirai masu dukiya,</t> <t>Adalcinsa zai tabbata har abada. <pb/></t>
<t>Haske yakan haskaka wa mutanen kirki a cikin duhu,</t> <t>Da waɗanda suke yin alheri, da jinƙai, da gaskiya.</t>
<t>Mai farin ciki ne mutumin da yakan ba da rance hannu sake,</t> <t>Wato wanda yake yin harkarsa da gaskiya.</t>
<t>Mutumin kirki ba zai kāsa ba daɗai,</t> <t>Ba za a taɓa mantawa da shi ba. <pb/></t>
<t>Ba ya tsoron jin mugun labari,</t> <t>Bangaskiyarsa tana da ƙarfi,</t> <t>Ga Ubangiji yake dogara.</t>
<t>Ba shi da damuwa ko tsoro,</t> <t>Ya tabbata zai ga faɗuwar maƙiyansa.</t>
<t>Yakan bayar ga matalauta hannu sake,</t> <t>Alherinsa kuwa dawwamamme ne.</t> <t>Zai zama mai iko wanda ake girmamawa.</t>
<t>Sa'ad da mugaye suka ga wannan,</t> <t>Sai suka tunzura, suka harare shi da fushi, suka ɓace,</t> <t>Sa zuciyarsu ta ƙare har abada.</t>
